about.sectionSubtitle: Our story, our passion, our commitment

history.title: Mr. Casteran Olivier
history.description:
My professional journey has led me to numerous experiences across France and internationally, as well as the creation of structures ranging from 15 to 120 employees.

I possess an in-depth understanding of the demands of our activities, and the necessary close collaboration between the Dental clinic and the laboratory.

Over my 30 years of professional practice, into which I have invested heavily and achieved much my experience, my expertise, and my choices led me to create DentCare Consultation in 2017 to meet the precise needs of dental practices.

To achieve this, I rely on two production sites: Hanoi (Vietnam) and Bordeaux (France).

Supporting your clinic daily in all prosthetic projects; our availability, attentiveness, communication, and proximity are our greatest assets.

My teams and I are fully invested and committed to quality, adhering strictly to working procedures and protocols. The Hanoi laboratory is ISO 13485 certified.

My ambition is to deliver excellent work at a reasonable cost.

method.title: Working Method
method.description: Complete mastery of the digital workflow: intraoral scanner, 3D printing, Zirconia milling, and implantology. Every step is controlled to guarantee absolute precision and results that exceed your expectations. Our team utilizes state-of-the-art CAD software for digital design, high-precision manufacturing equipment, and rigorous quality control protocols at every stage of production. We combine traditional craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology to deliver prosthetics that are both functionally superior and esthetically superior. Each prosthesis undergoes multiple quality checks before delivery to ensure it meets the highest international standards. Our commitment to excellence means your patients receive restorations that restore not just function, but also natural appearance and long-term durability.

detail.note: Technical explanation and illustration are displayed for each selected product.

zirconeMonolithic.name: Monolithic Zirconia
zirconeMonolithic.technical: A full-contour zirconia restoration designed for high fracture resistance and long-term stability in posterior and mixed-load zones.

zirconeStratified.name: Layered Zirconia
zirconeStratified.description: High esthetics for the anterior region.
zirconeStratified.technical: A zirconia core combined with hand-layered ceramic to reproduce natural translucency, texture and shade gradients for visible teeth.

ccm.name: Porcelain-Fused-to-Metal (PFM)
ccm.description: Reliable mechanical strength under high occlusal forces.
ccm.technical: Metal-ceramic crown/bridge solution offering robust fit, predictable longevity and broad indication coverage for functional restorations.

inlayCore.name: Inlay-Core
inlayCore.description: Core build-up to restore compromised abutments.
inlayCore.technical: Indirect post-and-core reconstruction used to rebuild a damaged tooth stump before final crown placement, improving retention and structural support.

waxup.name: Diagnostic WAX-UP
waxup.description: 3D or manual mock-up to preview treatment.
waxup.technical: A diagnostic modeling step used to validate occlusion, shape and smile line before preparation, ensuring a predictable esthetic outcome.

stratifiedVeneer.name: Layered Veneers
stratifiedVeneer.description: Hand-layered Emax ceramic for advanced esthetics.
stratifiedVeneer.technical: Custom layered veneer technique using Emax ceramic and manual stratification to optimize translucency, depth and individualized morphology.

monolithicVeneer.name: Monolithic Veneers
monolithicVeneer.technical: Single-structure ceramic veneers designed for enhanced durability and simplified maintenance while preserving esthetic integration.

screwRetained.name: Screw-Retained Solutions
screwRetained.description: Implant restoration fixed by screw retention.
screwRetained.technical: Direct screw fixation allows retrievability, easier maintenance and controlled passive fit for single and multi-unit implant prostheses.

cemented.name: Cemented Solutions
cemented.technical: Cement-retained prosthetic design selected for esthetic emergence profile and angulation flexibility where screw access is limited.

allOn.name: All-on Type
allOn.technical: Complete arch restoration supported by a reduced number of strategically placed implants to deliver immediate function and stability.

metalFrame.name: Metal Framework
metalFrame.technical: Digitally designed and laser-manufactured framework ensures precision fit, rigidity and long-term functional performance.

biosoft.name: Biosoft Flexible Resin
biosoft.description: Biocompatible flexible resin with improved comfort.
biosoft.technical: Soft-flex resin concept improves insertion comfort, gum adaptation and esthetic integration while reducing metallic visibility.

conventionalResin.name: Conventional Resin Appliance
conventionalResin.technical: Traditional resin prosthesis solution indicated for partial or complete rehabilitation with validated workflow and controlled cost.

flexibleResin.name: Flexible Resin
flexibleResin.technical: Advanced flexible resin offering superior comfort, easier insertion and natural esthetics for bilateral partial removable dentures.

attachementPrecision.name: Precision Attachment
attachementPrecision.technical: Precise mechanical attachments providing stable retention on implants with reliable support and simplified maintenance protocol.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Get answers to common questions about our services

items.question: What is the typical turnaround time for prosthesis fabrication?
items.answer: Our standard turnaround time is 5-7 business days for most prostheses, depending on complexity and materials selected. Expedited orders with 2-3 day turnaround are available for urgent cases. We coordinate closely with your clinic to ensure production schedules meet your patient treatment plans.

items.question: Which materials and brands does DentCare use for manufacturing?
items.answer: We work exclusively with premium-grade materials and respected brands including Vivodent SPE Triumph tooth sets, high-grade zirconia, E.max lithium disilicate ceramic, and titanium implant solutions. All materials are sourced from certified suppliers and comply with ISO 13485 and FDA standards. We can accommodate specific material preferences from our clients.

items.question: Do you offer digital workflow integration with intraoral scanners?
items.answer: Yes, we offer complete digital workflow integration. Our Bordeaux laboratory has integrated scanning services for impression digitization, implant planning, and digital design. We accept digital files from popular scanners including TRIOS, iTero, Cerec Omnicam, and Standard formats (STL, OBJ). This ensures maximum precision and speeds up the design process.

items.question: Is DentCare certified for medical device manufacturing?
items.answer: Yes, our Hanoi production facility is ISO 13485:2016 certified, which is the international quality management system standard for medical devices. This certification demonstrates our commitment to quality, traceability, and compliance with the most demanding international standards. All prostheses meet European CE Medical Device requirements.

items.question: Can DentCare handle complex implant cases?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our specialized implant team has extensive experience with screw-retained solutions, cement-retained bridges, all-on implant rehabilitations, and complex multi-implant cases. We provide virtual implant planning using advanced CAD software and can create surgical guides and custom abutments as needed.

items.question: What warranty and after-sales support does DentCare provide?
items.answer: We provide a 5-year warranty against manufacturing defects on all prostheses. Our warranty covers material defects and craftsmanship but excludes damage from handling or patient factors. We offer prompt modifications, repairs, and after-sales service through our Bordeaux coordination center to ensure your patients have ongoing support.

items.question: How does DentCare ensure precision in digital design?
items.answer: Our digital design process uses advanced CAD software with specialized dental libraries. Each design is reviewed by experienced technicians before production. We use precision manufacturing equipment including 5-axis milling machines and high-resolution 3D printers. Every prosthesis undergoes detailed visual inspection and fit verification before shipment.

items.question: Does DentCare ship internationally?
items.answer: Yes, we ship throughout France and internationally. We work with reputable logistics partners to ensure secure, timely delivery. International orders are handled with proper customs documentation and packaging. We can accommodate urgent international shipments when required. Contact our team for specific international quotes.

items.question: What is the difference between monolithic and layered zirconia?
items.answer: Monolithic zirconia restorations feature full-thickness zirconia material, offering superior strength and fracture resistance—ideal for high-stress posterior areas. Layered zirconia combines a zirconia core with hand-applied ceramic veneering, providing exceptional esthetic results with natural translucency and shade variation—perfect for visible anterior regions.

items.question: Can DentCare accommodate custom specifications for complex cases?
items.answer: Yes, we specialize in handling complex and customized cases. Our experienced team can work with custom anatomical specifications, unique color requirements, and specialized designs. We encourage direct communication with your clinic during the design phase to ensure the final prosthesis perfectly matches your clinical requirements.
